newsitem.title: MONACO: ATHLETICS-WORLD RECORD HOLDERS FOR SARAJEVO SOLIDARITY MEETING.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-WORLD RECORD HOLDERS FOR SARAJEVO SOLIDARITY MEETING.

text.p: World record holders Noureddine Morceli and Daniel Komen on Tuesday both called on "athletes of the world" to take part in an IAAF-backed meeting in war-ravaged Sarajevo next week.
The event, titled the Solidarity Meeting for Sarajevo, venue of the 1984 Winter Olympics, will be held in the rebuilt Kosevo Olympic stadium on Monday.

Morceli, the Algerian holder of three world records, said he wanted to race as "an inspiration to the young athletes of Bosnia and Herzegovina", the International Athletic Federation reported in a statement.
Kenyan Komen, who took a fourth world record, the 3,000 metres, away from Morceli last Sunday, said: "I will be in Sarajevo and I believe it is very important for everybody to go there."
